summary: Allocates a 572-byte heap block, constructs a mesh-resource object in it, stores a caller-supplied ID at dword index 15, and copies a name string into the object. On success writes the object pointer back through the output argument a1 and returns 0; on string-copy failure runs the object cleanup routine, frees the block, and returns -1.

operations.description: If the output pointer a1 is non-null, clear it to zero before any allocation.
Allocate a 572-byte heap block via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.
If the allocation returned non-null, construct the object at the block with sub_54A600; otherwise the object pointer stays null.
Run the mesh resource constructor sub_54A600 on the freshly allocated block.
Store the caller-supplied ID a4 into dword index 15 of the new object.
Copy the name string from a2 into the object via SelfCopyStringWithValidation, with a3 supplying the copy length.
If the string copy failed (non-zero return), tear the object down and return -1.
Run the object cleanup routine TwoFunctionCallChain on the failure path.
Free the object's heap block with FreeWrapper_7bcf on the failure path.
Return -1 on the string-copy failure path.
On success, write the constructed object pointer into *a1 when a1 is non-null.
